allowlist.justification: GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp affects satisfiesWithoutRevalidation with client max-stale in a shared cache. Astro 7.2.8 only imports this package in its remote-image loader and calls storable/timeToLive; this site uses no remote images or shared response cache. test/security-gates.test.mjs verifies the pinned call path. No patched npm release exists as of 2026-10-04; review when one is published.
